abstract: One-hundred-twenty-four germ cell tumors and 11 gestational choriocarcinomas were assessed immunohistochemically for the presence of the following placental markers: human chorionic gonadotrophin, human placental lactogen, and pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein, and for the expression of cytokeratin. A total of 40 cases contained syncytial trophoblastic cells, large mononuclear cells, or both. These cases included all gestational choriocarcinomas and choriocarcinomatous foci in 11 mixed germ cell tumors, 14 embryonal carcinomas, and four seminomas. Syncytial trophoblastic cells reactive for cytokeratin were identified in all choriocarcinomas, 12 embryonal carcinomas, and two seminomas. Human placental lactogen-reactive syncytial trophoblastic cells were observed in nine gestational choriocarcinomas, 10 choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors, four embryonal carcinomas, and one seminoma. Pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein-reactive syncytial trophoblastic cells were seen in 10 gestational choriocarcinomas, all choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors, 11 embryonal carcinomas, and one seminoma. Cytotrophoblasts, as expected, were identified only in choriocarcinomas. Cytokeratin-reactive cytotrophoblast was seen in all gestational choriocarcinomas and 10 choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors. Human chorionic gonadotrophin-reactive cytotrophoblast was observed in two gestational choriocarcinomas and three choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors. Cytotrophoblast was uniformly nonreactive for human placental lactogen and pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein. Cytokeratin-reactive large mononuclear cells were observed in 10 gestational choriocarcinomas, all choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors, five embryonal carcinomas, and three seminomas. Human placental lactogen-reactive large mononuclear cells were identified in nine gestational choriocarcinomas, seven choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors, one embryonal carcinoma, and one seminoma. Pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein-reactive large mononuclear cells were present in 10 gestational choriocarcinomas, 10 choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed germ cell tumors, two embryonal carcinomas, and two seminomas. Because of morphologic and immunohistochemical similarities of large mononuclear cells with intermediate trophoblast of the normal placenta and gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, we propose that the large mononuclear cells in gonadal and extragonadal germ cell neoplasms are equivalent to the intermediate trophoblast.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍124例および妊娠性絨毛癌11例を、胎盤マーカーであるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク、およびサイトケラチンについて免疫組織化学的に検討した。40例に栄養膜様の合胞体栄養膜細胞、大型単核細胞、またはその両方が認められた。これらの症例には、全ての絨毛癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の全ての絨毛癌成分、14例の胎児性癌、4例のセミノーマが含まれた。合胞体栄養膜細胞はすべての絨毛癌、12例の胎児性癌、2例のセミノーマでサイトケラチン陽性であった。ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン陽性の合胞体栄養膜細胞は、絨毛癌9例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分10か所、胎児性癌4例、セミノーマ1例に認められた。妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク陽性の合胞体栄養膜細胞は、絨毛癌10例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分すべて、胎児性癌11例、セミノーマ1例に認められた。栄養膜細胞は絨毛癌にのみ認められた。サイトケラチン陽性の栄養膜細胞は全絨毛癌と混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分10か所に認められ、β-hCG陽性の栄養膜細胞は絨毛癌2例と混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分3か所に認められた。栄養膜細胞はヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンおよび妊娠特異的β1糖タンパクに一様に陰性であった。サイトケラチン陽性の大型単核細胞は、絨毛癌10例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分すべて、胎児性癌5例、セミノーマ3例に認められた。ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン陽性の大型単核細胞は、絨毛癌9例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分7か所、胎児性癌1例、セミノーマ1例に認められた。妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク陽性の大型単核細胞は、絨毛癌10例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分10か所、胎児性癌2例、セミノーマ2例に認められた。大型単核細胞の形態と免疫組織化学的特徴が、正常胎盤の中間栄養膜細胞および妊娠性絨毛性疾患に類似することから、性腺内および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍における大型単核細胞を中間栄養膜細胞と同等とみなすことを提唱する。
